f203aa9c-a0a8-43db-bc8e-68fce342d93c.quote: The draft read unfavored on paper in three of five lanes -- carry, midlane and jungle -- with only the offlane reading favorably against Greystone. Lt. Belica opened first blood on Iggy & Scorch at 2.3. An even 1-1 skirmish at 6.8 went to them, followed by a five-man teamfight lost 2-3 at 9.1 near our river. From 16.3 on we started converting, taking their Outer Tower and then Fangtooth at 17.9. We fought that Fangtooth a body down after Murdock caught Wukong alone at 17.5, and still won 3-0. The costliest sequence of the night came at 21.3: a 2-4 loss left four of five of us dead and cost both our Inner and Outer Tower inside a minute, the single highest-significance fight in the match. From there we won every fight but one, trading a win at 26.2 for their Orb Prime across the map, and closed it out through Fangtooth, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth captures into their base. We finished with a 33-to-17 lead in majors and a lopsided 123,676-to-41,865 edge in objective damage, yet towers finished 8 to 9 -- they actually took one more of ours than we took of theirs, which is why a game this one-sided still ran 44 minutes.
